In some Valley cities, proving a project has its own water supply is a condition of building. Mission weighed a development pause over water in 2024. Edinburg has 127+ subdivisions under construction and has promised an independent water supply by 2030.

Watch the full breakdown on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auormf6yM2Q
